참고사항

- **현재 상태**: 알람 상태는 'CLEARED' 로 해제되었으나, 과거 최대 사용률이 임계치를 크게 초과했으므로 해당 서버의 메모리 용량 확충 또는 프로세스 최적화 검토가 필요합니다.

## 순차 처리 경과
- [t2] 선행 작업(t1) 결과 1대(name)로 대상을 한정했습니다. 선별 기준: 조건 max_val >= 90.
- polestar 컬럼 설명 미등록 — 컬럼 설명 없이 조회했습니다. 관리자 「DB 구조」 탭에서 컬럼 설명 등록이 필요합니다.
- [t2] 선행 스코프 밖 서버 2대의 행을 제외했습니다(SV-WEB-001, SV-BATCH-009).
done.executed_sql:
-- [t1]
SELECT
  MAX(CASE WHEN c.resource_type='server.Server' THEN c.name END) AS "name",
  ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN c.resource_type='server.Memory' AND s.definition_name='Utilization' AND s.max_val BETWEEN 0 AND 1000 THEN s.max_val END)::numeric, 2) AS "memory_max"
FROM polestar.cmm_resource c
LEFT JOIN polestar.core_config_prop cc ON cc.configuration_id = c.resource_conf_id
LEFT JOIN polestar.cmm_metric_stat_m s ON s.resource_id = c.id AND s.definition_name = 'Utilization'
WHERE c.resource_type IN ('server.Memory', 'server.Server')
  AND c.dtime IS NULL
GROUP BY COALESCE(c.platform_resource_id, c.id)
HAVING ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN c.resource_type='server.Memory' AND s.definition_name='Utilization' AND s.max_val BETWEEN 0 AND 1000 THEN s.max_val END)::numeric, 2) >= 90
LIMIT 1000;

-- [t2]
SELECT
  SVR.NAME AS server_name,
  D.NAME AS alarm_name,
  CA.ALARMSEVERITY AS severity,
  CA.CTIME AS ctime,
  CA.CONDITIONLOGTEXT AS conditionlogtext,
  CA.CURRENTALARMSTATUS AS currentalarmstatus,
  CR.NAME AS resource_name,
  SVR.IPADDRESS AS ipaddress,
  SVR.HOSTNAME AS hostname,
  CASE WHEN CA.ALARMSEVERITY = 3 THEN '심각' WHEN CA.ALARMSEVERITY = 2 THEN '경고' WHEN CA.ALARMSEVERITY = 1 THEN '주의' WHEN CA.ALARMSEVERITY = 0 THEN '해소' ELSE '기타' END AS severity_grade,
  TO_CHAR(CA.CTIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS occurred_at,
  CA.ID AS alarm_id
FROM polestar.cmm_resource CR
JOIN polestar.cmm_alarm CA ON CA.RESOURCE_ID = CR.ID
JOIN polestar.cmm_alarm_def D ON CA.DEFINITION_ID = D.ID
LEFT JOIN polestar.cmm_resource SVR ON SVR.ID = COALESCE(CR.PLATFORM_RESOURCE_ID, CR.SERVICE_RESOURCE_ID, CR.ID)
WHERE CR.DTIME IS NULL
  AND CA.ALARMSEVERITY IN (1, 2, 3)
ORDER BY CA.CTIME DESC, CA.ID DESC
LIMIT 1000;
